# langsmith_tool (Data Source)

Read a LangSmith **platform tool** from the registry (`GET /v1/platform/tools/{handle}` or `GET /v1/platform/tools/id/{id}`). Specify exactly one of `handle` or `id`. Use the same authentication as other data sources: `api_key` / `LANGSMITH_API_KEY`, and for org-scoped keys `tenant_id` / `LANGSMITH_TENANT_ID` (sent as `X-Tenant-Id`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_tool" "example" {
  handle = "example-tool-handle"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `handle` (String) Stable tool handle. Exactly one of `handle` or `id` must be set.
- `id` (String) Tool UUID. Exactly one of `handle` or `id` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (`created_at` field).
- `description` (String) Tool description from the API (`description` field).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the tool is enabled (`enabled` field).
- `metadata` (String) JSON object of tool metadata (`metadata` field).
- `name` (String) Human-readable tool name from the API (`name` field).
- `parameters` (String) JSON object describing tool parameters (`parameters` field).
- `returns` (String) JSON object describing return shape (`returns` field).
- `tenant_id` (String) Workspace tenant id associated with the tool (`tenant_id` field).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (`updated_at` field).
